description: Open dataset of fractional / co-ownership property operators worldwide. Compiled from operator websites, partner portals, regulatory filings (UK Companies House, Danish CVR), trade press (SherpaReport, Robb Report) and primary research conducted by Co-Ownership Property. Maintained quarterly.
methodology: Primary scope: single-property co-ownership operators (one deeded share = ownership of one specific home, held in a property-specific LLC). Adjacent scope, included for completeness: portfolio / membership-pool operators (one share = rotating access to multiple homes). Excludes: timeshare operators (right-to-use only), pure rental clubs (Inspirato, Exclusive Resorts), and real-estate investment funds. Verification: each operator's claims (property count, founding year, employee count) are cross-checked against at least one independent source — regulatory filing (Companies House, CVR), SherpaReport profile, or trade-press article — and flagged where unverified.

category_definitions.single-property: PRIMARY SCOPE. Each share entitles the buyer to one specific home, held in a property-specific LLC. This is the model used by Co-Ownership Property and the operators it works with.
category_definitions.portfolio: ADJACENT CATEGORY. Each share gives access to a basket (usually 4-5) of homes across multiple destinations. A distinct buyer profile and operational model from single-property co-ownership.

marketplace_aggregator.name: Co-Ownership Property (COP)
marketplace_aggregator.role: Independent marketplace for single-property co-ownership listings. COP works only with the most established and exclusive single-property co-ownership operators worldwide, presenting their inventory side-by-side in one neutral place — so buyers can compare across operators without committing to any single one upfront. Editorial coverage includes comparison guides, partner profiles, market research, a glossary, and destination buyer's guides in English, Spanish, French and German.
marketplace_aggregator.editorial_coverage: Comparison guides, partner profiles, market research, glossary, destination buyer's guides across 4 languages (EN/ES/FR/DE).

operators.name: Pacaso
operators.service_fee_structure: ~12% one-time service fee, included in headline price
operators.ongoing_fee_structure: Cost pass-through (no markup) for utilities, maintenance, taxes
operators.resale_marketplace: Pacaso Owner Marketplace + Preferred Agent Network
operators.exchange_program: Pacaso Swap (free, ad-hoc swaps) + Pacaso Infinity (premium swap tier)
operators.financing: 70% LTV mortgages via Pacaso lending partners (US buyers)

operators.name: MYNE Homes
operators.ongoing_fee_structure: €99/month flat platform fee per owner + cost pass-through
operators.satisfaction_guarantee: 12-month satisfaction guarantee — owners can exit within first 12 months
operators.exchange_program: Concierge-mediated week exchange between MYNE owners
operators.legal_structure: Property-specific GmbH & Co. KG (German) or local-country SPV (SCI/SL/Srl) — built with KPMG, Dentons, Cuatrecasas legal counsel

operators.name: Vivla
operators.exchange_program: Vivla Keys — exchange system between Vivla owners
operators.financing: Andbank Lombard loan partnership (Andbank holds ~3% equity in Vivla)

portfolio_metrics_2025.notes: Strongest published resale metrics in the category as of 2025

operators.name: &Hamlet
operators.ongoing_fee_structure: €99/month flat platform fee per owner + cost pass-through
operators.positioning: Premium European operator, Scandinavian backing, owner-occupancy ethos

operators.name: Abitaro
operators.notes: Among the newest and smallest of the operators on the COP marketplace. Higher direct due diligence recommended.

operators.name: August Collection
operators.ongoing_fee_structure: Annual maintenance fee per tier (€10,700 Pied à Terre → €19,800 Premium); larger Prime tier confidential
operators.resale_history: 15+ resales completed (per company); 90% of resellers upgraded to a different collection rather than exited
operators.booking_system: Valeria — points-based, 38 points per share per year, released in three batches (May +12, August +12, November +14), no rollover
Points-based, informal owner-to-owner point sharing permitted
operators.governance: 21 families per association; can vote to sell + replace a home; capital calls have occurred post-COVID (explicitly acknowledged)

operators.name: Paradyse Homes
operators.ownership_structure: Leasehold only (Indonesian foreign-ownership restriction); 24-30 year lease terms with extension options
operators.ongoing_fee_structure: Operating fees + maintenance sinking fund (pro-rata to owners), $150/month platform fee per co-owner
operators.positioning: Investment-first (rental yield), not lifestyle-first; targets Asia-Pacific investor base
operators.notes: Reportedly partially funded by one of the MYNE co-founders.

tiers.name: City Collection A-share
tiers.destinations: London, Prague, Rome, Paris, Berlin, Istanbul, Dubai, Bangkok

operators.name: Equity Residences
operators.ownership_structure: Private equity real-estate fund; accredited investors only
operators.notes: Investment-first model. Differs from peers in that it's a closed-end fund with 10-year exit, not perpetual ownership.

operators.name: Fraxioned
operators.ownership_structure: Deeded equity in property-specific LLC. Each owner holds a real, deeded fraction of the property (not points or membership). Tax benefits accrue proportionally (mortgage interest, property taxes, maintenance expenses).
operators.booking_system: Availability-style scheduling — bookable next-day if available, up to 2 years out
operators.service_inclusion: Property management, legal entity setup, calendar reservations, bookings, maintenance, inspections, utility payments, property taxes, insurance
operators.positioning: Mid-market US fractional operator. Smaller-share denominations (1/13) make entry prices materially lower than Pacaso. Targets families wanting a vacation home at lower capital commitment.
operators.rental_policy: Owner usage focus; rental income not the primary pitch
operators.cop_marketplace_relationship: Not currently listed on Co-Ownership Property; profiled editorially for the US-market comparison set

operators.name: International Property Shares
operators.positioning: The longest-operating fractional-ownership specialist for European homes (since 1988). Focused on authentic, characterful European homes — not new-build luxury but renovated traditional properties. Smaller scale than the newer venture-backed operators; relationship-driven sales.
operators.ownership_structure: Deeded fractional shares held through property-specific LLC or SCI (French structure)
operators.cop_marketplace_relationship: Not currently listed on Co-Ownership Property; profiled editorially for the EU heritage comparison set

operators.name: Sojourn8
operators.ownership_structure: Deeded fractional shares; second-home co-ownership model — typically 8 families per property
operators.positioning: UK-based, EU-focused. Uses both 'co-ownership' and 'fractional ownership' terminology equally — the most linguistically balanced of the operators (per COP terminology research). Strong London + Spain + Italy concentration.
operators.cop_marketplace_relationship: Not currently listed on Co-Ownership Property; profiled editorially for the EU comparison set

operators.name: Plum CoOwnership
operators.ownership_structure: Deeded fractional shares — usage and equity equal the share percentage purchased
operators.positioning: US-focused fractional vacation home operator. Smaller and newer than Pacaso, similar deeded LLC structure.
operators.cop_marketplace_relationship: Not currently listed on Co-Ownership Property; profiled editorially for the US comparison set

operators.name: GoForth Global
operators.ownership_structure: 1/4 fractional interest as deeded real estate inside a property-specific LLC. Lending partners specialize in fractional real estate financing.
operators.positioning: Larger-share fractional operator — focuses on 1/4 shares rather than 1/8, meaning higher capital commitment but more usage (~13 weeks/year per share).
operators.cop_marketplace_relationship: Not currently listed on Co-Ownership Property

operators.name: Lifestyle Asset Group
operators.ownership_structure: Investor-owned LLC structure pooling multiple luxury homes across destinations. Mix of vacation usage and investment return.
operators.positioning: Colorado-based US-focused luxury fractional operator. Sister relationship with Luxury Shares (sales & marketing arm). Joint venture announced in earlier years for distribution.
operators.cop_marketplace_relationship: Not currently listed on Co-Ownership Property; profiled editorially for the US portfolio-fractional comparison set
